tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Search checked answers about whether something is normal for a child aged 0–36 months (Polish content, Polish care path). Pass the parent's question or keywords in Polish and, if known, the child's age in months. Returns up to 5 matches, each with the page URL, last-checked date and the urgency pane

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Full checked answer for one question id from search_questions (e.g. 'Q001'): short answer, norm, when to worry, urgency panels (SOR / 112 first, then doctor), myths, sources with licences, page URL and last-checked date.
